visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair in a black pleated shirt is crouched on a large white mattress with a textured surface. A woman in a navy t-shirt and light grey trousers jumps onto the mattress, causing it to bounce slightly. A stack of ten orange plastic cups remains steady on the bed. (2) The man is shown in a close-up, looking at the orange cups. He gestures with his hand and then blows toward the cups, which remain unmoved. The background is a plain white wall with a power outlet. (3) The man is lying on the mattress with his eyes closed and hands clasped over his chest, resting on a white pillow. He has a serene, smiling expression. (4) The scene shifts to a studio setting where a woman in a red tank top and brown pants accidentally trips over a camera cable, causing the camera on a tripod to shake. A woman in the background looks shocked with her mouth open. (5) The woman in red bends down to fix the equipment. The man is sitting on the floor in the background, looking at her with a calm but slightly mocking smile. Production equipment like a softbox and reflectors are visible. (6) A final graphic screen appears with text overlays and a small inset video of the man falling onto a mattress.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced electronic BGM starts. A female voice shouts energetically in Mandarin, followed by the muffled thud of a body hitting a soft mattress. (2) The BGM persists. The main male speaker talks in a humorous tone with background laughter. (3) A group of voices chant ritualistically in Mandarin. The man responds with a high-pitched, exaggerated 'Yes'. (4) A sharp metallic thud and the sound of falling objects trigger a loud, high-pitched female scream of alarm. The BGM tempo shifts slightly. (5) Sounds of movement and cable rustling. A female voice apologizes quickly. The man jokes about salary cuts, leading to loud, clear group laughter. (6) Upbeat outro music plays over clear narration.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Demonstration -> Blooper -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a mattress by demonstrating its stability (not moving when jumped on) through a humorous behind-the-scenes format. It uses comedic accidents and a ritualistic parody to engage the audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: A mattress box clearly displaying the brand 'Emma' is shown during the chaotic studio scene.
